event_description: At the lunch rush peak, the queue at the main serving window has just cleared — only two adjacent stainless-steel trays remain on the return conveyor belt, and both arrive simultaneously to deposit theirs.

Inside the dimly lit warehouse bay, both pause mid-aisle beside the same stacked pallet of unopened cafeteria napkin boxes — the aisle is narrow, lined with identical pallets on both sides, leaving no room to pass without coordinated stepping.
